query: The Hat Matrix in Regression and ANOVA

record.title: The Hat Matrix in Regression and ANOVA
record.abstract: In least-squares fitting it is important to understand the influence which a data y value will have on each fitted y value. A projection matrix known as the hat matrix contains this information and, together with the Studentized residuals, provides a means of identifying exceptional data points. This approach also simplifies the calculations involved in removing a data point, and it requires only simple modifications in the preferred numerical least-squares algorithms.
